mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in employment (PAYEMS) correlates with increased consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in labor expansion periods are not statistically higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the federal funds rate below 3.5% triggers a signal of monetary easing, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in unemployment benefits (UNRATE) signals a coordinated monetary and labor market response, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction does not predict positive returns in 60% of triggered instances (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime where demand (GDPC1) is elevated and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is suppressed, S&P 500 forward returns are positively influenced over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive returns do not occur in 60% of instances where the regime condition is met (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment benefits (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market concerns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high demand (GDPC1) and low supply (INDPRO) creates inflationary pressure, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative returns are not observed in 60% of instances where the regime condition is met (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle marked by rising federal funds rates and falling unemployment benefits (UNRATE), S&P 500 forward returns are negatively influenced over the next 5 trading days due to reduced growth expectations.
failure_condition: The negative returns do not occur in 60% of instances where the regime condition is met (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
